image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small brown rabbit (likely a cottontail) sitting in green grass. The rabbit is facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Sunlight illuminates the right side of its face and ears, creating a warm glow and highlighting the texture of its fur. The background consists of out-of-focus green foliage.

The transition from the chin to the chest fur is somewhat indistinct. The fur texture here becomes blurry and lacks definition, blending into the grass in a way that suggests a slight failure in boundary separation rather than natural depth of field.
